description: This Java class 'ModelGrid' models the <grid> element in the OFBiz widget framework. It extends 'ModelForm' and provides functionality to parse XML elements representing grid configurations, including handling inheritance via 'extends' attributes. The class includes methods for accepting visitors and retrieving parent models, with logic to load parent grid definitions from resources or the same document.

classes.name: ModelGrid
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a grid XML element, supporting inheritance and visitor pattern.

methods.name: ModelGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelGrid instance from an XML element and context.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this model.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Retrieves the parent grid model based on 'extends' attributes, loading from resources or document as needed.
